faqs.question: What services does VYJOY Consultancy offer?
faqs.answer: VYJOY Consultancy specializes in Overseas Job Recruitment & Work Permits, Tourist & Visit Visas, International & Domestic Tour Packages, Passport Assistance, and MEA/Embassy Certificate Attestation.

faqs.question: Where is VYJOY Consultancy located?
faqs.answer: Our main office is located in Trichy, Tamil Nadu. Clients can visit us in person or complete document verification and consultation online via WhatsApp.

faqs.question: Which countries do you process tourist and visit visas for?
faqs.answer: We process tourist, visit, and business visas for Dubai/UAE, Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Bali, Schengen Europe countries, UK, USA, Australia, and GCC nations.

faqs.question: How do I apply for overseas jobs through VYJOY?
faqs.answer: Please send your updated Resume/CV, passport copy, and educational/experience certificates on WhatsApp. Our recruitment team will review your profile and match you with active employer openings in Gulf, Singapore, Malaysia, or Europe.

faqs.question: How long does certificate attestation take?
faqs.answer: State HRD attestation usually takes 7-10 working days, MEA Apostille takes 3-5 days, and Embassy attestation (UAE, Qatar, Kuwait, Saudi) takes 10-15 working days depending on the embassy.

Always provide transparent guidance on visa processing timelines and required documents
Always invite clients to visit the Trichy office or schedule a WhatsApp phone consultation
neverRules: Never guarantee 100% visa approval as issuance is strictly at the discretion of the embassy/consulate
Never promise unverified overseas job salaries without an official employer offer letter
Never collect unauthorized fees or compromise client privacy
